## Checklist

- [ ] One change per pull request
- [ ] Works on PHP 8.1 and WordPress 6.5
- [ ] No new third-party libraries, services, fonts, CDNs or telemetry
- [ ] No renamed slug, text domain, namespace, hooks, options or tables
- [ ] Output escaped, input sanitized, capabilities and nonces checked, SQL prepared
- [ ] A database change has a new `Schema::DB_VERSION` and an upgrade step
- [ ] Tests added for any behavior change
- [ ] Docs updated, and a line added under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, passwords or `wp-config.php` included
- [ ] Version number not changed

Which tests you ran, and their results. Say so if you could not run them.
